aboutGame.title: What is Maid Cafe Simulator?
paragraphs: Maid Cafe Simulator is a first-person cafe management sim where you and five kemonomimi maids turn a rundown cafe into a popular maid cafe and set your sights on three Maidchelin stars. You take orders, mix drinks at blenders, brewers and shakers, serve customers, scan receipts and count out change, and order ingredients by phone when supplies run low.

The main story runs 13 chapters, with 36 bond stories and 25 text messages per maid, plus late-night text stories that unlock as bonds deepen. Cafe levels go up to 40 and maid levels to 15, with hall and kitchen expansions, a Dance Stage for performances and a Performance Stage for filming nights. The game is single-player only.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common Maid Cafe Simulator questions from new cafe owners.

items.question: What is Maid Cafe Simulator?
items.answer: Maid Cafe Simulator is a first-person cafe management sim where you and five kemonomimi maids turn a rundown cafe into a popular maid cafe. Mix drinks, serve customers, run the register, order ingredients by phone, fulfill maid wishes, and aim for three Maidchelin stars.

items.question: How many maids are in Maid Cafe Simulator?
items.answer: Five kemonomimi maids join the cafe as the story brings them in. The official store listing bills them as five unforgettable maids, each with a secret of her own, and public patch notes and DLC listings name them: Omu, Mina, Yuki, Jennie and Momo.

items.question: How do I make money in Maid Cafe Simulator?
items.answer: Serving drinks and customers is the core income loop, with tips and reviews supporting it. Patch notes give practical detail: starting money is $150, rich customers carry $100 to $220, and if your money drops below $10 the regular otaku shows up early with money-making tips.

items.question: What should I upgrade first in Maid Cafe Simulator?
items.answer: Follow your current quest and check the bottleneck before spending. Hall expansion determines whether 3, 4 or 5 maids can work. The latest patch removes kitchen expansion from Episodes 5 and 7 requirements, while the Pro Blender and Pro Brewer each make two of the same drink per serving.

items.question: Does Maid Cafe Simulator have multiple endings?
items.answer: The verified information is limited: the full game continues past the demo and closes on an ending sequence with credits set to a vocal version of the theme. The official material we have does not confirm a set of true, route, solo or failure endings, so those are not covered here.
